				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<p>Nestled in the tranquil Tankinho neighborhood of Santa Maria, Sal, Pensão Alcinda Bettencourt offers a warm, family-friendly retreat just steps from the beach and just a short walk to the Pontão (pier), making it easy to explore the vibrant attractions and lively culture of Santa Maria.</p><p>At Pensão Alcinda Bettencourt, we blend comfort with genuine hospitality, ensuring you feel right at home from the moment you arrive. Whether you’re seeking relaxation by the sea or exciting adventures around the island, our friendly team is dedicated to making your stay unforgettable.</p>						</div>
